name: adjudicated-review
description: The convergent-review template (upstream-response-ow07-feedback S2+G5): reviewers discover, ONE adjudicator re-grades under a frozen scope, and the deterministic ledger gate keeps cross-round memory — reviewer->arbiter->gate is the shape that converged in the OW-07 campaign where gate-per-reviewer ping-ponged. args: subject (what to review — a path or short description), scope (the frozen scope statement: what this review is OF and what is out of bounds), ledger (repo-relative ledger path; lives in the repo because runs/ is gitignored and the memory must cross lineages). Full-review mode; for delta mode feed the reviewers a node_diff/worktree_diff probe's output and say so in the scope (FLOW-AUTHORING 'Convergent review'). To heal an implementer with it, wire this after the implementing node and point the gate's heal.targets at it — with "rollback": false (the refine-loop shape): a rollback restores every path since its baseline, the ledger included, erasing the memory this gate exists to keep (lint-ledger-rollback names the mistake).
